newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Klaus Jacobs has 99.2 percent of AFG.
newsitem.headline: Klaus Jacobs has 99.2 percent of AFG.

text.p: Klaus J. Jacobs Holding AG has accumulated a 99.2 percent stake in investment group Allgemeine Finanzgesellschaft AG (AFG) as a result of its extended tender offer that ended on Friday, Union Bank of Switzerland said.
Shareholders with 61,898 bearer shares, the equivalent of 97.15 percent of the 63,712 outstanding shares, had offered to sell their stock by the end of the period.
Including shares the Klaus Jacobs group already owned, its stake thus rose to 238,186 shares, or 99.24 percent of the capital and voting rights in AFG.

Jacobs in July offered 390 Swiss francs for the minority of shares it did not already own. Shares closed at 330 francs before the offer. Jacobs has said it would deslist the company if it acquired all the shares.
